summary.text: Ed Goodwin is a Republican member of the North Carolina House of Representatives from District 1, which he has represented since January 1, 2019, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired federal criminal investigator, he is also a farmer.

paragraphs.text: Ed Goodwin was born in Edenton, North Carolina, grew up on his family's farm, and graduated from John A. Holmes High School.
He enlisted in the U.S. Air Force in 1972, served four years, and received the Air Force Airman's Medal for Heroism.
He later earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice from East Carolina University in 1981.
Goodwin began his career in 1983 as a special agent with the Naval Criminal Investigative Service, and from 1989 to 1992 he was an INF Nuclear Arms Treaty Inspector in the former Soviet Union.
He retired in 2004 and returned to his hometown to start a farm.
Goodwin served on the Chowan County Board of Commissioners from 2008 to 2012 and did not seek re-election in 2012 because of a bid for North Carolina Secretary of State.
He succeeded Bob Steinburg in the state House.
